hooks: A $529 M.M.LaFleur Theodora dress is $111, in every size.
Hiperson leather knee boots, $324 down to $162, almost every size.

brands.verdict: Resortwear at 60% off with full size runs, but final sale and no returns outside the UK and EU.
brands.say: Harper dress, $152 from $380. Viscose, comes with a matching scarf, sheer and unlined.

items.why: Full-length viscose georgette with a cowl neck and a removable matching scarf; sheer and unlined.
items.for_who: Booked a warm trip this winter
items.skip_if: You need a lining or a return option

items.why: Mini dress in 70% cotton, 30% silk with a removable belt, all five sizes in stock.
items.skip_if: A plunging neckline or $192 final sale worries you

items.why: Semi-sheer viscose maxi that ties at the waist and wears open or closed, more robe than gown.
items.for_who: Wants a layer over a swimsuit
items.skip_if: You expected an evening gown; sizes S to L only

brands.verdict: Three boot styles at exactly half off, with nearly every size from 5 to 12 still there.
brands.say: Hiperson knee boot, $162 from $324. Tall, kitten heel, leather with a sheen.

items.why: Knee-high leather boot with a kitten heel and a sheen finish, in black and merlot.
items.skip_if: You want matte leather, or merlot in size 5

items.why: Suede knee boot with a low heel and inside zip, every size in chocolate and black.
items.skip_if: You'd rather not look after suede

items.why: Black leather Chelsea ankle boot with a curved heel, $129, all eight sizes in stock.
items.skip_if: The long snipped toe isn't your shape

brands.verdict: Sale goes to 60% off, earrings land around $50, and every single item is final sale.
brands.say: Alma clip-ons, $52 from $130. No piercing needed, three colors in stock.

items.why: Clip-on drop earrings the store calls lightweight, in gold, silver or gold and black.
items.for_who: No piercings, or gifting someone without
items.skip_if: Clip-ons bother your ears; final sale

items.why: Statement earrings at $44 from $110, left in one color, black velvet.
Oversized acetate aviators with brown tinted lenses, plus a pouch and cloth, $80 from $200.
items.skip_if: You need to try sunglasses on first

brands.verdict: A flat 40% off, but pairs still cost $366 to $399 and sizes are missing.
brands.say: Delicat sandal in red satin, $387 from $645. A 55 millimeter heel.

items.why: Strappy red satin sandal on a 55 mm heel; sizes 36, 36.5, 37.5 and 40.5 are gone.
items.for_who: Wants a low red evening sandal
items.skip_if: $387 is still a lot; tagged exchange only

items.why: Black calfskin kitten-heel mule with a buckle strap; 8 of 13 sizes left.
Round-toe Mary Jane flat in washed gold nappa, built to flex, sizes 36 to 41.
items.skip_if: $366 for flats, or you wear 35 or 42

brands.verdict: Sale section reaches 60% off; the blouse gets that, the blazer and coat are 40% and still expensive.
brands.say: Willa silk blouse, $150 from $375. All five sizes, 60% off.

items.why: A $375 silk blouse for $150, all five sizes in stock; the listing has no description.
items.for_who: Wants silk at under half price
items.skip_if: You want fabric details before buying

items.why: Blazer with strong shoulders, a slim body and embellished pinstripes, every size 0 to 14.
items.skip_if: $537 is more than you'd spend on a blazer

items.why: Oversized wool trench in a color called Hibiscus, $717 from $1,195, XS sold out.
items.skip_if: $717 is too much, or you wear XS

brands.verdict: Deepest cuts in this video, 73 to 82% off, full size runs on both dresses, final sale.
brands.say: Theodora dress, $111 from $529. Black eyelet midi, every size XS to XXL.

items.why: Sleeveless black eyelet midi with a collar and A-line shape, 79% off, XS to XXL.
items.skip_if: You want something to wear this month

items.why: Velveteen boyfriend blazer, slightly boxy and long, $143 from $529, sizes 6 to 18 only.
Machine-washable jersey wrap dress with three-quarter sleeves, $54 from $299, all six sizes.
items.skip_if: You don't want a print; final sale
